places.name: DYU Art Cafe
places.description: Serene Portuguese-style old courtyard house with lush plants, art exhibits, books, cold brews, and banoffee pie. Perfect for student hangouts and reading.
places.safetyNotes: Well-lit area, lively student neighborhood with auto stands nearby.

places.name: Koshy's Heritage Café
places.description: Iconic heritage cafe operating since 1940. Dark wooden furniture, vintage fans, steaming filter coffee, and appam stew frequented by student writers.
places.safetyNotes: Central Bangalore location, 3 minutes from MG Road Metro.

places.name: Third Wave Coffee
places.description: Modern specialty roaster with abundant electrical sockets, fast Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and great croissants for long study sessions.
places.safetyNotes: Active late-night road, security guard on duty.

places.name: Blossom Book House & Reading Loft
places.description: Famous 3-floor bookstore packed with thousands of rare, second-hand books, fiction, and textbooks with cozy reading corners.
places.safetyNotes: Located in pedestrian-only Church Street promenade.

places.name: State Central Library (Sheshadri Iyer Memorial)
places.description: Majestic red-brick European architectural monument inside Cubbon Park with soaring ceilings, historical archives, and pin-drop quiet.
places.safetyNotes: Inside park grounds, open during daylight and public hours.

places.name: VV Puram Food Street (Thindi Beedi)
places.description: The ultimate vegetarian street-food strip in Bengaluru. Over 40 stalls serving crispy paddle dosas, garlic buns, congress kadlekai, and rabdi jalebi.
places.address: Old Taluk Cutchery Rd, Sajjan Rao Circle, VV Puram
places.safetyNotes: Pedestrian street, very crowded on weekends, keep bags close.

places.name: Mosque Road Shawarma & Kebab Hub
places.description: Bustling Frazer Town strip famous for juicy rumali shawarmas, mutton seekh rolls, and sweet Sulaimani chai on a student budget.
places.safetyNotes: Busy main road, wide footpaths and well lit.

places.name: Vidyarthi Bhavan
places.description: Gandhi Bazaar legend since 1943. Waiters balancing 20 plates of thick, crispy golden butter masala dosas soaked in ghee with spiced potato filling.
places.safetyNotes: Basavanagudi heritage precinct, safe and family-friendly.

places.name: Nagarjuna Andhra Meals & Biryani
places.description: Spicy banana leaf Andhra meals with unlimited hot rice, dal, pappu, gun powder, ghee, and fiery chicken sholay kebab for group celebrations.
places.safetyNotes: Commercial district with valet and security.

places.name: Ranga Shankara Cultural Theatre
places.description: Premier performing arts theatre founded in memory of Shankar Nag. Plays in English, Kannada, Hindi, and their renowned hot sabudana vadas at the cafe.
places.safetyNotes: Residential cultural hub, metro feeder buses connected.

places.name: Urvashi Digital 4K Cinema
places.description: Giant single-screen cinema theatre famous for massive curved screen, earth-shaking Dolby Atmos sound, and budget movie ticket prices for blockbusters.
places.safetyNotes: Directly off Lalbagh main road, close to Lalbagh metro station.

places.name: Amoeba Bowling & Arcade
places.description: Lively gaming zone with a 12-lane bowling alley, air hockey tables, basketball hoops, and racing simulators for fun competition with friends.
places.safetyNotes: Directly on Church Street with active security staff.

places.name: Cubbon Park (Sri Chamarajendra Park)
places.description: 300-acre green heart of Bengaluru with bamboo groves, shaded avenues, heritage statues, dog park sessions, and tranquil lawns for student picnics.
places.safetyNotes: Dedicated park police patrols, safe walking avenues.

places.name: Sankey Tank Promenade
places.description: Serene man-made lake in Sadashivanagar with a landscaped walking perimeter, sunset views over the water, and migratory birds.
places.safetyNotes: Security at entry gates, fenced lake edges.

places.name: Bull Temple (Nandi Temple) & Bugle Rock
places.description: 16th-century Dravidian temple carved out of a single monolithic granite rock, set right next to Bugle Rock park and green amphitheatre.
places.safetyNotes: Temple premises well-maintained with shoe storage and drinking water.

places.name: Bangalore Palace & Royal Grounds
places.description: Tudor-revival palace inspired by England’s Windsor Castle, featuring fortified towers, stained glass, vintage wood carvings, and sprawling gardens.
places.safetyNotes: Gated heritage compound with guided security.

places.name: Commercial Street Bargain Avenues
places.description: The heartbeat of affordable street shopping in Bangalore. Alleyways brimming with college clothes, sneakers, jackets, jewelry, and street chaat.
places.safetyNotes: Crowded market, watch personal belongings, best reached by metro.

places.name: Nandi Hills Sunrise & Cloud Bed
places.description: Legendary hill fortress 1,478m above sea level. Sunrise over the rolling mist, Tipu’s Drop cliff edge, and chill cool breezes for student morning rides.
places.safetyNotes: Wear warm jackets, roads have hairpin bends, watch for monkeys.

places.name: Turahalli Forest Viewpoint
places.description: Bangalore’s only remaining natural forest hill. Huge boulders to climb, panoramic views of the city skyline, and cycling trails.
places.safetyNotes: Forest reserve, visit in daylight with friends.

places.name: Church Street Graffiti & Street Art
places.description: Vibrant pedestrian cobblestone street adorned with colorful murals, neon cafe signboards, indie bookstores, and street musicians.
places.safetyNotes: Pedestrian boulevard with regular police patrol.

places.name: Ramanagara Silk Cocoon & Sholay Rocks Trek
places.description: Granite boulder paradise where movie Sholay was filmed. Epic sunrise trek, rock climbing, and camping for an unforgettable Saturday day trip.
places.safetyNotes: Wear grippy hiking shoes, carry water bottles and snacks.

places.name: Hudson Lane Student Cafes (Big Yellow Door)
places.description: DU North Campus holy grail for students. Cheesy nachos, thick shakes, pasta combos, and rustic wooden interiors at student prices.
places.safetyNotes: Lively student hub, GTB Nagar metro right nearby.

places.name: Lodhi Gardens Heritage Park
places.description: 90-acre lush architectural park dotted with 15th-century Sayyid and Lodi tombs, sprawling manicured lawns, and ancient stone bridges.
places.safetyNotes: Central diplomatic area, high security.

places.name: Marine Drive & Queen's Necklace
places.description: 3.6-kilometer seaside promenade along the Arabian Sea. Cool sea breezes, tetrapod seating, cutting chai, and golden sunsets with friends.
places.safetyNotes: Well patrolled by Mumbai Police 24/7, very safe for students.

places.name: Prithvi Café & Theatre
places.description: Legendary open-air cultural cafe lit with fairy lights, bamboo furniture, famous Irish coffee, parathas, and live creative student conversations.
places.safetyNotes: Juhu theatre precinct, lively evening crowd.

places.name: FC Road & Cafe Vaishali
places.description: The epicenter of Pune student life. SPDP (Sev Potato Dahi Puri), Mysore masala dosa, filter coffee, and post-lecture hangout under shaded trees.
places.safetyNotes: Student collegiate zone with footpaths and active street lights.

places.name: DLF Cybercity Late-Night Street Food
places.description: Famous 24/7 IT corridor street food stretch with crispy maggi, spicy egg dosas, chicken shawarma, momos, and chai for night-owl students.
places.address: Gachibowli, Near DLF Cyber City Gate 2
studentPerks: Open Till 4 AM for Exam Study Breaks
places.safetyNotes: Constantly populated and well-lit by IT tech parks.

places.name: Rushikonda Beach & Sea View Promenade
places.description: Golden sand beach surrounded by lush green Eastern Ghats. Surfing schools, beachside speedboats, and student-friendly seafood stalls.

places.name: Araku Valley Coffee Gardens & Borra Caves
places.description: Enchanting hill station in Eastern Ghats with rolling coffee plantations, tribal culture museums, and million-year-old stalactite Borra Caves.
places.address: Araku Valley, Alluri Sitharama Raju District

places.name: Tirupati & Silathoranam Natural Rock Arch
places.description: Ancient spiritual gateway nestled in the Seshachalam Hills featuring a rare prehistoric geological rock arch and serene garden viewpoints.

places.name: Bhavani Island & Krishna River Promenade
places.description: One of the largest river islands in India nestled on the Krishna River with rope courses, canopy walks, boat rides, and riverbank picnics.

places.name: Lepakshi Temple & Monolithic Nandi
places.description: Iconic 16th-century Vijayanagara architectural wonder near Gorantla featuring the world-famous Hanging Pillar, monolithic granite Nandi, and rock carvings.

places.name: Gorantla Madhava Raya Temple
places.description: Historic Vijayanagara-era temple located right in Gorantla town with carved pillars, spacious stone mandapams, and a peaceful ambiance for study breaks.

places.name: Anantapur Clock Tower Uggani Bajji Street
places.description: The ultimate Rayalaseema comfort food hub! Famous hot crispy mirchi bajjis served with spicy lemon puffed rice (Uggani) and badam milk for under ₹50.

places.name: Charminar & Laad Bazaar Street Food Walk
places.description: World-famous 16th-century monument surrounded by buzzing markets serving authentic Irani Chai, Osmania biscuits, mutton haleem, and pearl bazaars.

places.name: Warangal Fort & Thousand Pillar Temple
places.description: Magnificent Kakatiya architecture featuring intricately carved stone toranas (gateways), star-shaped temples, and lush garden walking trails.

places.name: Srisailam Dam Viewpoint & Tiger Reserve Trek
places.description: Spectacular gorge viewpoints overlooking the deep turquoise waters of the Krishna River surrounded by Nallamala dense forest hills.

places.name: Hampi Bouldering & Virupaksha Sunset Ruins
places.description: UNESCO World Heritage open-air museum of giant surreal boulders, ancient banana plantations, riverside coracle boat rides, and Hippie Island cafes.

places.name: Coorg Abbey Falls & Raja's Seat Mist View
places.description: The "Scotland of India" with misty coffee estates, cascading waterfalls, spicy Kodava street curries, and panoramic western ghat sunset gazebos.

places.name: Gokarna Om Beach & Cliff Trek Path
places.description: Laid-back paradise for college squad treks connecting Kudle Beach, Om Beach, Half Moon Beach, and Paradise Beach through rocky sea cliffs.

places.name: Munnar Tea Hills & Top Station Clouds
places.description: Breath-taking emerald tea gardens stretching into clouds at 1,700m elevation. Crisp mountain air, Neelakurinji flower hills, and cozy hillside tea stalls.

places.name: Alleppey Backwaters & Kayaking Canals
places.description: The "Venice of the East". Glide through tranquil palm-fringed lagoons, rural paddy fields, and traditional village waterways on budget wooden shikaras.

places.name: Fort Kochi Art Street & Chinese Fishing Nets
places.description: Colonial Portuguese and Dutch alleys brimming with contemporary street murals, indie bohemian cafes, antique curio shops, and sunset sea breezes.

places.name: Varkala Red Cliff & North Cliff Cafes
places.description: Dramatic geological red laterite cliffs towering over the Arabian Sea with chilled-out beach shacks, Tibetan shops, yoga lofts, and live acoustic music.

places.name: Ooty Nilgiri Toy Train & Doddabetta Peak
places.description: UNESCO Heritage steam railway chugging through 250 bridges and pine forests to the highest peak in Nilgiris at 2,637m with telescope house views.

places.name: Madurai Meenakshi Amman Temple & Jigarthanda Hub
places.description: Towering colorful Dravidian gopurams with 33,000 sculptures, vibrant flower markets, and the legendary cool Madurai Famous Jigarthanda drink.

places.name: Kodaikanal Star Lake & Coaker's Walk
places.description: Princess of Hill Stations featuring a giant star-shaped lake with pedal boating, misty pedestrian cliffside paths, and pine forest cycle tracks.

places.name: Lonavala Tiger's Leap & Bhushi Dam Trek
places.description: Iconic Western Ghats getaway for college squads. Sheer 650m cliff with roaring wind, cascading monsoon waterfalls, and hot sweet chikki stalls.

places.name: FC Road & Cafe Vaishali Student Strip
places.description: The heartbeat of Pune collegiate life since 1949. Hot SPDP (Sev Potato Dahi Puri), Mysore masala dosas, filter coffee, and post-lecture banter under trees.

places.name: Marine Drive & Girgaon Chowpatty Sunset
places.description: The Queen's Necklace curved 3.6km seaside promenade. Cool sea breeze, tetrapods, cutting chai, pani puri, and late-night talks with friends.

places.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Colorful Streets
places.description: Heritage Portuguese quarter with pastel yellow and blue villas, vintage balconies, narrow cobblestone streets, and cozy indie bakeries.

places.name: Anjuna Beach & Curlies Sunset Rocks
places.description: Legendary bohemian seaside destination with volcanic red rock formations, Wednesday flea markets, beach shacks, and vibrant student party vibe.

places.name: Hawa Mahal & Pink City Bazaars
places.description: Iconic 5-story pink honeycomb palace with 953 jharokhas (windows). Rooftop cafes opposite the facade offer prime photo views and ginger tea.
places.address: Badi Choupad, J.D.A. Market, Pink City

places.name: Lake Pichola Ghats & City Palace Vista
places.description: The "City of Lakes" romantic jewel. Watch golden sunsets reflect off Lake Pichola from Ambrai Ghat with bagpipers and temple bells.

places.name: Sam Sand Dunes & Desert Safari Camp
places.description: Golden Thar desert dunes for camel trekking, stargazing under clear skies, folk dances by campfires, and quad biking adventures.

places.name: Taj Mahal & Mehtab Bagh Sunset View
places.description: One of the Seven Wonders of the World. Glowing ivory-white marble mausoleum on the Yamuna riverbank with symmetrical Mughal reflection pools.

places.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat & Evening Ganga Aarti
places.description: The oldest living city in the world. Mystical evening Aarti ceremonies with bronze brass lamps, rhythmic chants, boat rides, and famous Banarasi kachori.
studentPerks: Free Aarti Viewing from Ghat Steps

places.name: Rumi Darwaza & Hazratganj Kebab Walk
places.description: City of Nawabs heritage trail. 60-foot Awadhi monumental gateway, the acoustic maze of Bara Imambara, and world-renowned Galouti Kebabs.
studentPerks: Free Monument Exterior Lighting at Night

places.name: Laxman Jhula & White Water River Rafting
places.description: Yoga capital of the world on the banks of clear emerald Ganga. Thrilling Grade III river rafting, cliff jumping, Beatles Ashram, and rooftop vegan cafes.

places.name: Naini Lake & Snow View Point Cable Car
places.description: Eye-shaped mountain lake surrounded by seven verdant peaks. Rowboat sailing, Mall Road evening walks, and Himalayan mountain panorama vistas.

places.name: Old Manali Bohemian Cafes & Solang Valley
places.description: Chill cedar forest enclave filled with live jam sessions, rustic wooden pizza cafes, trout fishing, and adrenaline-pumping Solang valley paragliding.

places.name: Kasol & Chalal Parvati River Walk
places.description: Backpacker's haven nestled beside roaring Parvati River with pine forest suspension bridges, Israeli shakshuka cafes, and trailheads to Kheerganga.

places.name: Shimla Ridge & Mall Road Heritage Walk
places.description: Classic colonial summer capital promenade with neo-Gothic Christ Church, panoramic views of snow-capped Shivalik ranges, and street pastries.

places.name: Darjeeling Tiger Hill Sunrise & Kanchenjunga
places.description: Witness the sunrise paint Mount Kanchenjunga in gold and crimson at 2,590m. Follow with steaming cups of Muscatel tea and colonial bakeries.

places.name: College Street Boi Para & Indian Coffee House
places.description: The world's largest second-hand book market spanning 1.5km. Heritage 1876 coffee house frequented by Nobel laureates, poets, and student debaters.

places.name: Konark Sun Temple & Chandrabhaga Beach
places.description: 13th-century colossal stone chariot of the Sun God with 24 carved wheels and erotic reliefs. Pair with clean golden sands of Chandrabhaga beach.

places.name: Puri Golden Beach & Jagannath Temple Street
places.description: Blue Flag certified pristine beach with rolling waves of the Bay of Bengal, sand art displays, and authentic Khaja sweet stalls.
studentPerks: Crispy Crab and Fish Fry under ₹100

places.name: Rann of Kutch White Desert & Salt Flat Sunset
places.description: The world's largest salt desert sparkling like snow under the sun and moonlight. Camel cart rides, Kutchi embroidery, and Rann Utsav cultural nights.

places.name: Sabarmati Riverfront & Manek Chowk Night Food
places.description: Modern 11km riverfront promenade with cycle tracks, followed by the buzzing midnight food court serving chocolate sandwiches and Gwalior dosas.
places.address: Riverfront West & Manek Chowk, Old City
studentPerks: Open till 2 AM for Exams Study Breaks

places.name: Khajuraho Western Group of Temples
places.description: UNESCO World Heritage sandstone masterpieces from 950 AD depicting celestial celebration of life, dance, spirituality, and love.

places.name: Sarafa Bazaar Midnight Street Food Street
places.description: Jewelry market by day, food paradise by night! Famous Bhutte Ka Kees, Garadu, giant Jalebas, Joshi's flying dahi vada, and kulfi.

places.name: Mahabodhi Temple & Bodhi Tree Meditation
places.description: The sacred place where Prince Siddhartha attained enlightenment under the Bodhi Tree in 588 BCE. Monasteries built by Japan, Bhutan, and Thailand.

places.name: Nalanda Mahavihara Ancient University Ruins
places.description: The world's premier residential university active from 5th to 12th century with red-brick stupas, lecture halls, and sprawling student dormitories.

places.name: Kaziranga Elephant Safari & One-Horned Rhinos
places.description: Vast Brahmaputra floodplain grasslands hosting two-thirds of the world's great one-horned rhinoceros population, wild water buffaloes, and tigers.

places.name: Umananda Island & Brahmaputra Sunset Cruise
places.description: The smallest inhabited river island in the world right in the middle of mighty Brahmaputra river. Affordable public ferry and peacock island walks.

places.name: MG Marg Pedestrian Boulevard & Ropeway
places.description: Clean eco-friendly smoke-free pedestrian mall lined with fairy lights, Himalayan momo corners, rooftop karaoke cafes, and cable car aerial views.

places.name: Nohkalikai Falls & Double Decker Living Root Bridges
places.description: Tallest plunge waterfall in India dropping 340m into a turquoise pool, paired with the legendary bio-engineered Ficus tree living root bridges.

places.name: Tawang Monastery & Sela Pass Frozen Lake
places.description: Second largest monastery in the world at 3,000m altitude with painted Buddhist mandalas, chanting monk halls, and snow-clad mountain passes.

places.name: Chitrakote Waterfalls (Niagara of India)
places.description: India's widest waterfall spanning 300 meters across the Indravati river. Roaring horseshoe plunge with boat rides directly up to the mist spray.

places.name: Dassam Falls & Hundru Rapids Nature Trek
places.description: Spectacular 44m natural staircase falls cascading over Nick Point rocks on the Kanchi River surrounded by dense green sal forest canopy.

places.name: Cyber Hub & Galleria Food Promenade
places.description: High-energy open-air pedestrian amphitheatre with gourmet food trucks, gaming lounges, microbreweries, and student hangout terraces.

places.name: Loktak Lake & Sendra Floating Phumdis
places.description: The largest freshwater lake in Northeast India, famous for its unique circular floating biomass islands (Phumdis) and dancing Sangai deer sanctuary.

places.name: Reiek Tlang Mountain Peak & Heritage Village
places.description: Spectacular cliff top peak at 1,548m overlooking the emerald hills of Mizoram and plains of Bangladesh, with preserved traditional Mizo huts.

places.name: Dzukou Valley Trek & Kisama Heritage Village
places.description: The "Valley of Flowers of the East" with rolling green velvet hills, natural rock shelters, crystal streams, and the annual Hornbill Festival grounds.

places.name: Golden Temple (Harmandir Sahib) & Langar Hall
places.description: Sacred gold-leafed gurdwara rising from the holy Amrit Sarovar pool. 24/7 volunteer-run mega Langar kitchen feeding 100,000 people free daily.

places.name: Ujjayanta Palace & Neermahal Water Palace
places.description: Stunning white neoclassical royal palace set within Mughal gardens, alongside Neermahal — eastern India's only lake water palace in Rudrasagar.

places.name: Radhanagar Beach & Elephant Beach Snorkel
places.description: Voted one of Asia's best beaches. Powder-white sand, clear turquoise waters, coastal coral reef snorkeling, and sunset kayaking in mangroves.

places.name: Sukhna Lake Promenade & Rock Garden
places.description: Iconic 3km rain-fed lake at the foothills of the Himalayas, paired with Nek Chand's surreal 40-acre wonderland crafted entirely from recycled urban waste.
studentPerks: Solar Boat Rides on Sukhna Lake

places.name: Diu Fort & Nagoa Beach Horseshoe Bay
places.description: 16th-century sea fortress surrounded on three sides by the Arabian Sea with stone cannons, paired with Nagoa Beach's semi-circular African Hoka palm bay.
places.state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
studentPerks: Free Entry to Historic Sea Fort

places.name: DU North Campus & Hudson Lane Cafes
places.description: The holy grail of student life in Delhi. Cheesy nachos, thick shakes, pasta combos, and rustic wooden interiors at unbeatable student prices.

places.name: Chandni Chowk Paranthe Wali Gali & Red Fort
places.description: 300-year-old historic culinary lane serving deep-fried stuffed parathas with pumpkin sabzi, rabdi jalebi, and night views of the Red Fort ramparts.

places.name: Dal Lake Shikara Ride & Floating Flower Market
places.description: Glide on mirror-still waters framed by Pir Panjal peaks. Traditional ornate wooden shikaras, floating artisan markets, and Mughal Nishat Bagh gardens.

places.name: Gulmarg Gondola & Apharwat Peak Snowfields
places.description: One of the highest cable cars in the world reaching 3,980m. Powder snow skiing, snowboarding, panoramic snow vistas, and pine forest snow treks.

places.name: Pangong Tso Crystal Blue High-Altitude Lake
places.description: World-famous 134km endorheic lake changing shades from turquoise to cobalt blue at 4,225m altitude framed by barren rugged Himalayan peaks.

places.name: Leh Main Bazaar & Shanti Stupa Sunset
places.description: White-domed Buddhist stupa on Changspa hilltop offering breathtaking panoramic sunset views of Leh town, Namgyal Tsemo Gompa, and Indus valley.

places.name: Agatti Island Lagoon & Coral Atolls
places.description: Pristine 7km coral island with transparent turquoise lagoons, sea turtles, scuba diving on coral reefs, and tranquil coconut palm shores.

places.name: White Town French Quarter & Promenade Beach
places.description: Mustard-yellow French colonial villas with bougainvillea draped balconies, chic bakeries with croissants and baguettes, and the rock beach promenade.

places.name: Auroville Matrimandir & Solar Kitchen Cafe
places.description: Universal experimental township dedicated to human unity. Golden geodesic meditation dome surrounded by lush green tranquility gardens.

places.name: Penukonda Fort & Gagan Mahal Palace
places.description: Ancient hill citadel and second capital of the Vijayanagara Empire. Climb to the watchtower ruins for sweeping views of the Rayalaseema valley and sunset.
places.address: Penukonda Hill, Sri Sathya Sai District

places.name: Puttaparthi Chaitanya Jyothi & Peace Gardens
places.description: Serene world-renowned spiritual center with grand lotus-shaped architecture, Chinese and Japanese style roof pagodas, peaceful reflection lawns, and hill viewpoints.

places.name: Gandikota "Grand Canyon of India" Gorge & Fort
places.description: Breathtaking 300-foot deep river canyon carved by the Pennar River into red granite cliffs. Camping on cliffs, ancient fort gates, and star gazing for college groups.

places.name: Chai Shai & Student Hangout Point
places.description: Popular local student meeting spot in Gorantla town. Authentic brewed ginger chai, badam milk, fresh veg sandwiches, and breezy evening seating.
places.address: Main Road, Near RTC Bus Stop, Gorantla

places.name: Highway Cafe 44 & Student Bistro
places.description: Modern air-conditioned highway cafe with great coffee, grilled wraps, cold brews, and power outlets for laptop study sessions.

places.name: Gorantla Youth Reading Hall & Digital Library
places.description: Quiet public reading space with daily newspapers, exam reference books, peaceful fan-cooled seating, and high-speed Wi-Fi.

places.name: Sri Sathya Sai Central Library & Meditation Grounds
places.description: Sprawling peaceful university library pavilion with thousands of academic and philosophical volumes, manicured gardens, and pin-drop silence.

places.name: Gorantla Bus Stand Ghee Karam Dosa & Mirchi Bajji Corner
places.description: Legendary morning and evening street food haven. Crispy red chilli chutney dosas, hot mirchi bajjis stuffed with onions, and fresh coconut chutney.

places.name: Sri Venkateswara Picture Palace
places.description: Historic single-screen cinema theatre in Gorantla town offering big-screen mass entertainer films with Dolby digital sound at student pocket rates.

places.name: Balaji V-Max Multiplex & Entertainment
places.description: Dual-screen modern cinema hall near Gorantla featuring pushback seats, 4K projection, and student weekday offers.

places.name: Highway Royal Dhaba & Late Night Tiffin
places.description: 24/7 highway student haunt serving hot rotis, spicy egg bhurji, dal tadka, and midnight parottas for night road-trippers and exam studiers.

places.name: Hindupur Night Food Street & Biryani Point
places.description: Buzzing late night street food lane near the station. Famous for midnight chicken pakoda, hot tiffins, and aromatic biryani parcels.

places.name: Gorantla Handloom Weavers Colony & Silk Market
places.description: Direct weaver market in Gorantla known for traditional hand-woven cotton kurtas, dhotis, and sarees at authentic factory prices.

places.name: Dharmavaram Silk & College Fest Shopping Street
places.description: Famous silk and ethnic shopping paradise where college student groups shop for traditional fests and graduation celebrations.

places.name: Penukonda Sports Hub & Snooker Lounge
places.description: Student recreational zone with snooker tables, 8-ball pool, table tennis, and box cricket turf.

places.name: Penukonda Hill Ghat Open Air Sunset Dhaba
places.description: Elevated open terrace and valley-facing outdoor restaurant on the slopes of Penukonda Hill with panoramic sunset views across the plains.

places.name: Yogi Vemana Forest Reserve & Samadhi
places.description: Lush green forested pilgrimage grove dedicated to the revered Telugu philosopher poet Yogi Vemana. Shaded trees, peaceful natural ponds, and trekking trails.

places.name: Thimmamma Marrimanu World Record Banyan Tree
places.description: Guinness World Record holding giant banyan tree covering over 5 acres with thousands of aerial roots forming a natural forest canopy. Spectacular day-out for student squads.
studentPerks: Cool Natural Breeze Even in Summer

places.name: Horsley Hills Hill Station & Viewpoint
places.description: Charming mist-shrouded hill resort at 4,100 feet altitude with eucalyptus forests, adventure ropes, and sweeping sunset cliffs. The top weekend ride for college students.
studentPerks: Scenic Ghat Hairpin Bends Bike Trip

places.name: Sri Venkateswara Swamy Temple (Tirumala Balaji)
places.description: World-renowned sacred hilltop temple in the Seshachalam Hills. Historic Dravidian gold-plated Ananda Nilayam vimana, iconic laddu prasadam, and scenic trekking footpaths (Alipiri & Srivari Mettu) popular with students.
places.address: S Venkata Ramana Temple Rd, Tirumala

places.name: Kapila Theertham Waterfalls & Shiva Temple
places.description: Ancient Shiva temple nestled right at the base of the Tirumala hills where a roaring mountain waterfall plunges into a sacred stone tank. Peaceful vibes and lush rocky scenery for student visits.

places.name: Sri Bhramaramba Mallikarjuna Swamy Jyotirlinga Temple
places.description: One of the most sacred pilgrimage sites in India housing both a Shiva Jyotirlinga and a Shakti Peeth. Set amidst the deep gorges and tiger reserve forests of the Nallamala Hills overlooking the Krishna River.
studentPerks: Srisailam Dam Ghat Road Scenic Drive

places.name: Ahobilam Nava Narasimha Swamy Sacred Cave Temples
places.description: Renowned 9 Narasimha cave temples distributed through dense Nallamala forest hills. Incredible adventure trekking route across Bhavanashini river streams and natural limestone caverns.

places.name: Kadiri Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple
places.description: Historic Rayalaseema pilgrimage landmark close to Gorantla. Exquisite Vijayanagara pillared corridors, towering Raja Gopuram, and huge festival chariot (Theru) that students visit during weekend road trips.
studentPerks: Close to Gorantla & Puttaparthi (45 min drive)

places.name: Penukonda Fort & Sri Kasi Visweswara Temple
places.description: Ancient hill fort capital of the Vijayanagara Empire located minutes from Gorantla. Features mountain watchtowers, Gagan Mahal palace, and sacred historic temples at the scenic hilltop ridge.

places.name: Yaganti Sri Uma Maheshwara Temple & Growing Nandi
places.description: Mystical 15th-century temple set against towering red sandstone cliffs. Famous for the monolithic Nandi idol that constantly expands in size, Pushkarini perennial spring, and saint Agastya cave.

places.name: Mahanandi Temple & Natural Mineral Springs
places.description: Enchanting temple bordered by lush mango orchards and emerald paddy fields. The temple tank contains crystal-clear mountain water where you can clearly see a coin at the bottom.

places.name: Sri Durga Malleswara Swamy (Kanaka Durga) Temple
places.description: Splendid ancient temple perched high on Indrakeeladri Hill over the flowing Krishna River and Prakasam Barrage. Beautiful ghat road views and evening illumination over Vijayawada.

places.name: Simhachalam Sri Varaha Lakshmi Narasimha Temple
places.description: Iconic 11th-century hill shrine covered in sandalwood paste (Chandanotsavam). Features ornate Kalinga and Chola architectural stone carvings overlooking the Visakhapatnam hills and sea.
studentPerks: Direct RTC Buses from Vizag Station

places.name: Madurai Meenakshi Sundareswarar Amman Temple
places.description: World-famous 2,500-year-old architectural masterpiece with 14 colorful towering gopurams, the Hall of Thousand Pillars, musical stone columns, and golden lotus tank in heart of Madurai.
studentPerks: Jigarthanda Cold Drink Street Stalls nearby

places.name: Ramanathaswamy Temple & 22 Sacred Theerthams
places.description: Magnificent island temple renowned for having the longest pillared corridor in the world (1,212 granite pillars). Located by the Bay of Bengal and Pamban Sea Bridge.

places.name: Brihadeeswara Temple (Thanjavur Big Temple)
places.description: 1,000-year-old UNESCO World Heritage granite wonder built by Raja Raja Chola I. The world’s first all-granite temple featuring an 80-tonne single stone dome cap and colossal Nandi statue.

places.name: Shore Temple & Pancha Rathas UNESCO Heritage
places.description: 7th-century rock-cut stone temples standing on the shores of the Bay of Bengal in Mamallapuram. Carved monolithic chariots, open-air bas-relief of Arjuna’s Penance, and ocean breeze.

places.name: Sri Virupaksha Temple & Stone Chariot
places.description: Active 7th-century sanctuary in the heart of the Hampi UNESCO ruins beside the Tungabhadra River. Features the 50-meter gateway tower, boulder landscapes, and the famous Vittala stone chariot.
studentPerks: Coracle Boat Rides on Tungabhadra River

places.name: Murudeshwar Shiva Temple & Giant Coastal Statue
places.description: Iconic 123-foot colossal Shiva statue surrounded on three sides by the Arabian Sea. Features a 20-story modern Rajagopuram with a glass lift taking students to the panoramic top viewing gallery.
studentPerks: Scuba Diving at Netrani Island nearby

places.name: Sri Chamundeshwari Temple & Chamundi Hill
places.description: Historic hilltop temple perched 1,000 meters above Mysuru palace city. Iconic 1,008 stone steps pilgrimage climb, 16-foot monolithic black granite Nandi bull, and panoramic sunset viewpoints.

places.name: Sri Krishna Matha & Temple
places.description: 13th-century spiritual sanctuary founded by saint Madhvacharya. Unique silver-plated 9-holed window (Kanakana Kindi), daily vegetarian annadanam feast for all visitors, and serene car street.
studentPerks: Close to Malpe Beach & St. Mary’s Island (15 min)

places.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple & Ganga Ghats
places.description: One of the twelve sacred Jyotirlingas located on the western bank of the holy River Ganga. The new grand Kashi Vishwanath Corridor leads directly to Manikarnika and Dashashwamedh Ghats.
studentPerks: Evening Ganga Maha Aarti Boat View ₹150

places.name: Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Mandir
places.description: Magnificent newly consecrated traditional Nagara-style pink Bansi Paharpur sandstone temple complex on the banks of the Saryu River in Ayodhya. Intricate carved stone pillars and serene spiritual courtyards.
studentPerks: Saryu River Evening Light & Sound Show

places.name: Banke Bihari Temple & Prem Mandir
places.description: Devotional heart of Braj Bhoomi. Prem Mandir is built of Italian white Carrara marble with mesmerizing evening multicolor LED illuminations depicting Krishna leelas.
studentPerks: Free Entry to Prem Mandir Grounds

places.name: Sri Harmandir Sahib (The Golden Temple)
places.description: The preeminent spiritual shrine of Sikhism. Golden marble sanctum surrounded by the sacred Amrit Sarovar lake, operating the world’s largest free community kitchen (Langar) feeding 100,000 people daily.
studentPerks: Open 24 Hours with Golden Night Reflections

places.name: Kedarnath Dham Himalayan Temple
places.description: One of the highest and holiest of the twelve Jyotirlingas, perched at 3,584 meters altitude against the snow-covered Kedarnath mountain peaks and Mandakini River. Bucket-list Himalayan trek for college students.
studentPerks: Breathtaking 16 km Mountain Trek from Gaurikund

places.name: Badrinath Temple & Neelkanth Peak
places.description: Sacred Char Dham shrine situated in the Chamoli district between the Nar and Narayana mountain ranges, with the pyramidal peak of Neelkanth in the background along the roaring Alaknanda River.
studentPerks: Mana Village (First Indian Village) 3 km away

places.name: Somnath Jyotirlinga Temple by Arabian Sea
places.description: The first of the twelve sacred Aadi Jyotirlinga shrines located right where the Arabian Sea waves crash against the temple walls. Majestic Chalukya-style stone architecture and sound & light show.
studentPerks: Sunset Walk along Arabian Sea Promenade

places.name: Shree Jagannath Temple & Grand Road
places.description: Monumental 12th-century temple dedicated to Lord Jagannath, Balabhadra, and Subhadra. World-famous for the annual Ratha Yatra festival, the mysterious non-flying flag, and Asia’s largest kitchen preparing Mahaprasad.

places.name: Konark Sun Temple & Stone Chariot Wheels
places.description: 13th-century UNESCO World Heritage architectural marvel designed in the shape of a colossal chariot with 24 carved stone wheels pulled by seven galloping horses on Chandrabhaga beach.

places.name: Mahakaleshwar Jyotirlinga & Mahakal Lok
places.description: One of the most powerful Shiva Jyotirlingas in India on the banks of Shipra River. Famous for the sacred dawn Bhasma Aarti and the 900-meter Mahakal Lok corridor lined with 108 grand stone pillars.
studentPerks: Free Entry to Grand Mahakal Lok Corridor
Ram Ghat Evening Aarti on Shipra

places.name: Kailasa Rock-Cut Temple (Cave 16)
places.description: The largest monolithic rock excavation in the world! Chiseled vertically from top to bottom out of a single volcanic basalt cliff face by Rashtrakuta kings. Astounding engineering and spiritual wonder.
studentPerks: Over 34 Caves to Explore with Friends

places.name: Kamakhya Temple & Nilachal Hill
places.description: Ancient tantric Shakti Peeth perched atop Nilachal Hill overlooking the majestic Brahmaputra River. Mesmerizing beehive-shaped dome architecture and spiritual panoramic viewpoints over Guwahati.

places.name: Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine & Holy Cave
places.description: Renowned holy cave shrine situated in the Trikuta Mountains at an altitude of 5,200 feet. The scenic 12 km illuminated mountain track from Katra is a milestone spiritual trek for student groups.
studentPerks: Illuminated Night Mountain Trek with Friends
